content:
kari_sales: Quick emergency ask from ACME Security — they put vendor-risk as a hard stop. They need a compact bundle: (1) EU-only data flow diagram, (2) subprocessor roster that identifies who touches PII, and (3) a short SIG/CAIQ-style pasteable blurb on encryption, segmentation, and key control. Deadline: tomorrow morning. Can we assemble and drop here?

noah_presales: Yep, can do. Plan: 1-page DFD PNG showing ingress, model runtime, KV cache, KMS boundaries, and storage; CSV with columns (processor, role, data_classes_touched, region, eu_residency_yes_no, notes); and a one-paragraph CAIQ-ready answer. Quick Q: ACME insisted PII never leaves EU — confirm Dedicated pinned to EU is fine?

kari_sales: They prefer Dedicated EU-only but said Hosted is acceptable only if we can guarantee no cross-border backups and disable region fallback.

isla_security: Technical constraints to call out in the pack: customer-managed KMS in EU is supported and recommended; Redwood HSM option exists (HSM-backed KMS) but split-escrow only under explicit contract. KV cache: ephemeral in Hosted; persistent Redis only on Dedicated/Private with EU placement. Metrics/telemetry: must be pseudonymized/aggregated before any export and stored in EU-only buckets. Backups containing PII must be disabled.

noah_presales: Draft paste-in config to lock Hosted to EU (include in deliverable):
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  region_policy:
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
    allow_fallback: false
storage:
  backups:
    enabled: false
    retention_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent_kv: false
kms:
  customer_managed: true
  default_rotation_days: 90
```

noah_presales: Subprocessor CSV preview rows (will export full CSV):
- Google Cloud (compute/storage) | infra | encrypted customer blobs (may contain PII) | europe-west3 | yes | EU-only zones for this config
- Datadog | monitoring | metrics (pseudonymized) | eu-tenant | yes | metrics pre-aggregate before export
- Sentry | error-tracking | traces (PII scrubbed) | eu-hosts | yes | PII redaction enabled
- Zendesk | support | ticket metadata | eu-tenant | yes | residency flag on contract
- HashiCorp Vault / customer KMS | key-management | key material | customer/EU | yes | customer-supplied recommended
- Internal log pipeline (ELK) | logging/archival | logs (PII redacted) | eu-storage | yes | S3 EU bucket

isla_security: Additions: audit logs and access logs can be exported to EU-only retention buckets; audit retention configurable per DPA. KMS rotation recommended 90 days; keys access logged and require multi-person approval for escrow release. Include statement that Redwood does not export raw PII as part of telemetry.

fran_legal: Please include this sample notification clause in the CSV/pack: "Redwood will notify Customer at least 30 days before engaging any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object and require mitigation. Details of subprocessors and subprocessors' EU residency will be shared and can be contractually restricted in the DPA." I will follow up with adapted DPA language if they ask.

noah_presales: CAIQ/SIG-ready one-paragraph (pasteable): "Redwood enforces encryption in transit (TLS1.2+) and at-rest (AES-256). Tenant-level logical segregation is applied across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes. Dedicated and Private deployments use VPC-level segmentation and tenant-dedicated compute; Hosted provides strict per-tenant isolation with region pinning and optional VPC peering. Customers may supply and manage their own KMS keys (recommended) to ensure key sovereignty; Redwood's HSM-backed KMS is available for customers that contract split-escrow. Audit logging and key access events are retained and exportable to EU-only storage endpoints."

kari_sales: That paragraph should cover the SIG fields nicely. Can you also add a short sentence mapping to evidence: "SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 mappings available under NDA"?

fran_legal: Yes add that line. Also when posting subprocessors include a column for contract status (standard / EU-only addendum / custom). We'll need that for procurement.

noah_presales: Pricing bullet for their expected 50 RPS: Hosted (EU-pin, reserved burst) = baseline list (we'll put concrete numbers in the bundle); Dedicated (EU-only reserved capacity) ~= +42% vs Hosted for committed monthly capacity that meets 50 RPS with low-latency SLOs; Private on-prem = separate SOW (one-time setup + ongoing support). I'll include a small TCO table in the deliverable.

isla_security: Also state operational constraint: KV cache persistence introduces disk-backed storage for context; if customer requires zero-disk persistence we can configure ephemeral-only mode but at cost to token throughput. Call that out in the DFD notes.

kari_sales: Great. ETA?

noah_presales: I'll assemble DFD PNG, full subprocessor CSV, CAIQ doc, pricing delta note, and include the legal clause. Dropping artefacts here in ~6 hours. Will upload DFD first (PNG) and link it.

redwood-bot: asset uploaded: /internal/security/dfd/1812345678-acme-eu-only-dfd.png (sha256:9d4f8b2a7c1e)

isla_security: Thanks. When you upload the CSV please tag the column headers exactly as planned so procurement can import.

fran_legal: After artefacts are posted, I'll prepare an email template to send to ACME-security with the bundle and next steps for evidence under NDA.

kari_sales: Perfect 64f. Once the bundle is here I'll send to ACME-security and set a follow-up call. If they push for live evidence, we'll loop security/legal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

noah_presales: Will post artefacts. Checklist: [x] Confirm EU-only PII requirement, [x] DFD PNG uploaded, [ ] Subprocessor CSV to upload, [ ] CAIQ paragraph doc to upload, [ ] Pricing note to upload, [ ] Legal clause sample attached. ETA ~6 hours.
